Complete Protection for Birds & Household Pets

CATEGORY 01

Anti-Pigeon & Bird Exclusion Nets

Stops pigeons, mynas, and crows from nesting on balconies, AC compressor brackets, and window sills. Prevents lung-damaging fungal spores (Histoplasmosis) and acidic guano corrosion.

  • 0.7mm Translucent UV-treated nylon monofilament
  • 28mm square diamond mesh (prevents head entry)
  • Zero shadow, 100% natural breeze and daylight
  • Stainless steel anchor hooks & high-torque wire border
Starting with custom site quote / sq.ft
CATEGORY 02

Pet & Animal Balcony Safety Nets

Playful cats and energetic dogs frequently chase birds or insects off high-rise balcony ledges. Our reinforced high-density polyethylene netting creates an impenetrable safety boundary.

  • 1.5mm to 2.5mm heavy-gauge knotless virgin HDPE
  • 150 kg/m² instantaneous impact resistance
  • Non-toxic, chew-resistant, claw-proof weave
  • Covers open balcony railings, french windows & voids
Starting with custom site quote / sq.ft
